about: The collecta of the formulary “First Sunday of Lent” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O God, Who purifiest Thy Church by the yearly observance of Lent, grant unto Thy household that what it striveth to obtain from Thee by abstinence it may accomplish by good works. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
g: for a year, lasting/appointed for a year
observation, attention, action of watching/taking notice
